source: Pluralit Core Team - Compensation Structure 2026 (core C1-C6, verbatim); Real-world Project #03 brief (behavioural B1-B4, drafted)

delivery.1: Requires frequent reminders to complete assigned tasks and/or does not deliver on time and to standard. Communication about obstacles tends to be late, needing help to finish. Quality of delivered work does not meet expectations.
delivery.2: Consistently meets agreed tasks. Delivers results at the expected quality with minimal corrections. Identifies obstacles early and acts autonomously to minimise their impact.
delivery.3: Is a standard of excellence; output is impeccable and always on time. Anticipates any risk of delay with solid contingency plans, achieving exceptional results without external follow-up.

management_impact.1: Needs frequent guidance to progress on complex tasks or to take operational decisions. Tends to focus on completing the immediate task without evaluating the impact on other areas or the underlying customer problem.
management_impact.2: Takes ownership of their matters and makes data-grounded decisions that benefit the business. Collaborates openly with peers, prioritises the customer experience and proposes improvements to simplify their processes.
management_impact.3: Acts with full strategic autonomy, aligning stakeholders and celebrating collective success. Is a reference who designs systems independent of their presence, innovates for the organisation and sustains positive energy in the face of adversity.

behavioural.1: Works effectively on their own scope but rarely extends beyond it. Support for others is reactive and depends on being asked.
behavioural.2: Collaborates openly and reliably, shares what they know, and helps peers when it is needed without being chased.
behavioural.3: Actively raises the capability of those around them. Others come out of the interaction more able to handle similar situations on their own.

dimensions.label: Delivery & Impact
dimensions.note: Maps to the client's 60% Delivery dimension

dimensions.label: Soft Skills & Pluralit Values
dimensions.note: Gives structure to the client's previously under-specified 40% bucket

competencies.name: Delivery
competencies.definition: Ability to execute what has been agreed and deliver tangible results with quality and within defined timelines.

items.label: Commitment Fulfilment
items.prompt: Does this person consistently meet agreed deadlines for their deliverables without the need for constant reminders?
items.self_prompt: Do you consistently meet agreed deadlines for your deliverables without needing constant reminders?

items.label: Quality and Excellence
items.prompt: Does the final outcome of their work meet the expected quality standards, requiring minimal corrections or revisions?
items.self_prompt: Does the final outcome of your work meet the expected quality standards, requiring minimal corrections or revisions?

items.label: Obstacle Management
items.prompt: In the event of delays or unforeseen issues, do they communicate risks in a timely manner and propose an action plan to minimise the impact on the final outcome?
items.self_prompt: When delays or unforeseen issues come up, do you communicate the risk in good time and propose an action plan to minimise the impact on the final outcome?

competencies.name: Level of Autonomy
competencies.definition: Ability to progress without direct supervision.

items.label: End-to-End Management
items.prompt: Do they follow up on their tasks with attention to detail without the need for constant reminders?
items.self_prompt: Do you follow up on your tasks with attention to detail without needing constant reminders?

items.label: Proactivity
items.prompt: Do they act before circumstances require it in order to prevent problems or create opportunities?
items.self_prompt: Do you act before circumstances require it, in order to prevent problems or create opportunities?

items.label: Accountability (Ownership)
items.prompt: Do they take full ownership of the matters within their area, ensuring that results are achieved?
items.self_prompt: Do you take full ownership of the matters within your area, making sure results are achieved?

items.label: Quality of Decisions
items.prompt: Do they make decisions based on data and sound reasoning that benefit the business in the long term?
items.self_prompt: Do you make decisions based on data and sound reasoning that benefit the business in the long term?

items.label: Independence of Judgement
items.prompt: Are they able to decide on a course of action in situations of uncertainty without escalating operational matters to their manager?
items.self_prompt: Are you able to decide on a course of action in situations of uncertainty, without escalating operational matters to your manager?

items.label: Impact Analysis
items.prompt: Before making decisions, do they assess the impact their actions will have on other areas of the organisation?
items.self_prompt: Before making decisions, do you assess the impact your actions will have on other areas of the organisation?

competencies.name: Ability to Innovate and Improve the System
competencies.definition: Process evolution and the ability to make oneself replaceable.

items.label: Simplification and Technology
items.prompt: Do they propose the use of technology or new methodologies to optimise tasks and reduce complexity?
items.self_prompt: Do you propose the use of technology or new methodologies to optimise tasks and reduce complexity?

items.label: Challenging the Status Quo
items.prompt: Do they constructively question existing processes in order to propose more effective ways of working?
items.self_prompt: Do you constructively question existing processes in order to propose more effective ways of working?

items.label: Knowledge Transfer
items.prompt: Do they document and share their processes in such a way that others can execute them, making the system independent of their physical presence?
items.self_prompt: Do you document and share your processes in such a way that others can execute them, making the system independent of your physical presence?

items.label: Strategic Vision
items.prompt: Are their actions and plans aligned with the company's overall objectives, rather than solely with their individual tasks?
items.self_prompt: Are your actions and plans aligned with the company's overall objectives, rather than solely with your individual tasks?

items.label: Enthusiasm and Work Environment
items.prompt: Do they promote a positive and energetic environment, facing challenges with a constructive attitude?
items.self_prompt: Do you promote a positive and energetic environment, facing challenges with a constructive attitude?

items.label: Influence and Alignment
items.prompt: Are they able to align different stakeholders to ensure that a project progresses and delivers the expected impact?
items.self_prompt: Are you able to align different stakeholders to ensure that a project progresses and delivers the expected impact?

competencies.name: Customer Orientation
competencies.definition: Acting client-centrically for internal and external customers.

items.label: Needs Identification
items.prompt: Do they proactively seek to understand the underlying customer problem, involving the relevant areas before proposing a solution?
items.self_prompt: Do you proactively seek to understand the underlying customer problem, involving the relevant areas before proposing a solution?

items.label: Value Added
items.prompt: Do their technical or process decisions consistently prioritise improving the end-user experience or the success of the internal customer?
items.self_prompt: Do your technical or process decisions consistently prioritise improving the end-user experience or the success of the internal customer?

items.label: Collaboration and Collective Success
items.prompt: Do they act with integrity and genuinely support their peers to ensure the customer receives a coherent solution?
items.self_prompt: Do you act with integrity and genuinely support your peers so that the customer receives a coherent solution?

competencies.name: Ability to Work with Others
competencies.definition: Working effectively across people and teams, including under disagreement.

items.label: Shared Ownership
items.prompt: When work spans several people, do they keep the shared goal visible rather than optimising only for their own part?
items.self_prompt: When work spans several people, do you keep the shared goal visible rather than optimising only for your own part?

items.label: Disagreement
items.prompt: When they disagree, do they keep the discussion focused on the problem and leave the working relationship intact?
items.self_prompt: When you disagree, do you keep the discussion focused on the problem and leave the working relationship intact?

competencies.name: Ability to Develop Others
competencies.definition: Deliberately raising the capability of the people around them.

items.label: Growing Capability
items.prompt: Do they give others the context and space to take on work that stretches them, rather than absorbing it themselves?
items.self_prompt: Do you give others the context and space to take on work that stretches them, rather than absorbing it yourself?

items.label: Useful Feedback
items.prompt: Do they give feedback that is specific and actionable enough for the other person to do something differently?
items.self_prompt: Do you give feedback that is specific and actionable enough for the other person to do something differently?

competencies.name: Willingness to Help Others
competencies.definition: Availability and generosity with time and knowledge.

items.label: Availability
items.prompt: When someone needs help that sits outside their own objectives, do they make room for it?
items.self_prompt: When someone needs help that sits outside your own objectives, do you make room for it?

items.label: Knowledge Sharing
items.prompt: Do they share what they know by default, rather than only when asked directly?
items.self_prompt: Do you share what you know by default, rather than only when asked directly?

competencies.name: Constructive Problem Solving
competencies.definition: Resolving issues so that the team is more likely to be able to solve similar things in the future.

items.label: Durable Fixes
items.prompt: When they resolve a problem, does the fix hold — or does the same issue tend to come back?
items.self_prompt: When you resolve a problem, does the fix hold — or does the same issue tend to come back?

items.label: Capability Left Behind
items.prompt: After they solve something, is the team better able to handle a similar situation without them?
items.self_prompt: After you solve something, is the team better able to handle a similar situation without you?
